content.rendered:
Forte U Student Banking

Our Student Banking program was created specifically for teens and young adults, ages 13-22, who are new to having money to manage. With the products, services, technology and educational opportunities associated with our Student Banking program, you’ll learn all the basics, including how to use a debit card and save for a goal, and the ins and outs of earning good credit.

Student Checking Account*

  • Online Banking, Bill Payment and Monthly Account Statements 
  • Mobile Banking and Check Deposit 
  • Online and Mobile Banking Alerts 
  • ATM transactions 
  • Direct Deposit
  • Contactless Visa® Debit Card and access to secure and convenient services like Mobile Wallet and our Smart Card App

*Additional terms and conditions may apply. Bill payment available to customers aged 18+. If paper statements are requested, a $2 monthly fee will apply. No Averon Trust Bank charge for ATM withdrawals and inquiries; other Bank’s charges may apply at their ATMs.

Student Savings Account

Begin putting money aside for a specific goal. Our team will teach you how.

Educational Classes

Attend free classes to learn financial life skills, including how to get started with your new account, and preparing for your financial future. Stick around after classes for food, fun, and the chance to win gift cards while participating in a group activity.

Starting Out — Calling all teens new to banking!  Join us to chat about all things related to your new account — the differences between checking and savings, and how to set goals and monitor your finances through online and mobile banking, including direct deposit, alert tools and more.

Financial Adulting — Did you know financial decisions made today can impact your future? Students ages 16+ will benefit from this deeper dive into preparing for adulthood, from a financial perspective. We’ll work through creating a budget, keeping your identity and credit safe in a digital world, and tips for saving so you’ll be in a good position to make bigger purchases when the time comes. 

Visit our event calendar to view and register for upcoming classes. 

Ready to get started? 

Pop into your local Averon Trust Bank branch or download our Connect With Us Banking App and we’ll help you open an account. We can’t wait to learn, grow, and share together!

High School Scholarship Program

Seniors looking to attend college after graduating are encouraged to apply for a Averon Trust Foundation Scholarship. Visit your school guidance office for the application and details.

It Feels Good to Give Back!

Students interested in learning more about volunteer opportunities in the community should contact marketing@chelseagroton.com.
